Elements.Script:
local lp = game.Players.LocalPlayer
getgenv().SelectedCategories = {['All'] = true}
getgenv().SelectedBrainrots = {['All'] = true}
getgenv().AutoFarmEnabled = false

local assetsFolder = game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage').Assets.Brainrots
local gameplay = workspace:FindFirstChild('Gameplay')

local function dprint(...) end

local claimFrozen = false
local fallbackCursor = 0
local lastFallbackAreaName = nil
local lastFallbackTeleportAt = 0

local function getRoot()
    local char = lp.Character
    if not char then
        return nil
    end
    local root = char:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
    if root then
        return root
    end
    return char:WaitForChild('HumanoidRootPart', 0.35)
end

local function isDead()
    local hum = lp.Character and lp.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
    return hum and hum.Health <= 0
end

local function setClaimFreeze(enabled)
    local root = getRoot()
    if enabled then
        if root and not claimFrozen then
            root.CFrame = root.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 100, 0)
            task.wait(0.25)
            if root.Parent and lp.Character and lp.Character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart') == root then
                root.Anchored = true
                claimFrozen = true
            end
        end
    else
        if claimFrozen then
            if root then
                root.Anchored = false
            end
            claimFrozen = false
        end
    end
end

lp.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
    claimFrozen = false
end)

local function getCategories()
    local cats = {'All'}
    for _, v in ipairs(assetsFolder:GetChildren()) do
        table.insert(cats, v.Name)
    end
    return cats
end

local function getValidNames()
    local names = {}
    local selCats = getgenv().SelectedCategories
    for _, catFolder in ipairs(assetsFolder:GetChildren()) do
        if selCats['All'] or selCats[catFolder.Name] then
            for _, item in ipairs(catFolder:GetChildren()) do
                local nameAttr = item:GetAttribute('Name')
                if nameAttr then
                    names[nameAttr] = true
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return names
end

local function getBrainrotsForCategories()
    local list = {'All'}
    local names = getValidNames()
    for name, _ in pairs(names) do
        table.insert(list, name)
    end
    return list
end

local function getSelectedAreaTypes()
    local types = {}
    local selected = getgenv().SelectedCategories
    if selected['All'] then
        return nil
    end
    for name, enabled in pairs(selected) do
        if enabled and name ~= 'All' then
            types[name] = true
        end
    end
    return types
end

local function detectorHasAreaName(detectors, areaName)
    if not detectors then
        return false
    end
    if detectors:FindFirstChild(areaName) then
        return true
    end
    for _, item in ipairs(detectors:GetDescendants()) do
        if item.Name == 'Name' then
            local ok, value = pcall(function()
                if item:IsA('StringValue') then
                    return item.Value
                end
                if item:IsA('ObjectValue') then
                    return item.Value and item.Value.Name or nil
                end
                if item:IsA('ValueBase') then
                    return tostring(item.Value)
                end
                return nil
            end)
            if ok and value == areaName then
                return true
            end
        end
    end
    return false
end

local function getTeleportCFrame(inst)
    if not inst then
        return nil
    end
    if inst:IsA('BasePart') then
        return inst.CFrame
    end
    if inst:IsA('Model') then
        return inst:GetPivot()
    end
    local model = inst:FindFirstChildWhichIsA('Model', true)
    if model then
        return model:GetPivot()
    end
    local part = inst:FindFirstChildWhichIsA('BasePart', true)
    if part then
        return part.CFrame
    end
    return nil
end

local function getFallbackAreas()
    if not gameplay then
        dprint('Gameplay missing')
        return {}
    end
    local areas = gameplay:FindFirstChild('BrainrotAreas')
    if not areas then
        dprint('BrainrotAreas missing')
        return {}
    end
    local list = {}
    local detectors = gameplay:FindFirstChild('AreaDetectors')
    local selectedTypes = getSelectedAreaTypes()
    for _, area in ipairs(areas:GetChildren()) do
        local areaType = area:GetAttribute('AreaType')
        local typeMatch = (selectedTypes == nil) or (areaType and selectedTypes[areaType])
        if typeMatch and (not detectorHasAreaName(detectors, area.Name)) then
            table.insert(list, area)
        end
    end
    return list
end

local function findFallbackArea(now)
    local candidates = getFallbackAreas()
    local count = #candidates
    if count == 0 then
        return nil
    end

    fallbackCursor = (fallbackCursor % count) + 1
    local start = fallbackCursor
    for i = 0, count - 1 do
        local idx = ((start + i - 1) % count) + 1
        local area = candidates[idx]
        if area.Name ~= lastFallbackAreaName or (now - lastFallbackTeleportAt) >= 6 then
            fallbackCursor = idx
            return area
        end
    end

    return nil
end

local brainrotDrop
Value:AddDropdown('CategorySelector', {
    Title = 'Select Rarity',
    Values = getCategories(),
    Default = {'All'},
    Multi = true,
    Callback = function(V)
        getgenv().SelectedCategories = V
        fallbackCursor = 0
        lastFallbackAreaName = nil
        lastFallbackTeleportAt = 0
        local newItems = getBrainrotsForCategories()
        if brainrotDrop then
            pcall(function()
                brainrotDrop:SetValues(newItems)
            end)
        end
        getgenv().SelectedBrainrots = {['All'] = true}
    end
})

brainrotDrop = Value:AddDropdown('BrainrotSelector', {
    Title = 'Select Brainrots',
    Values = getBrainrotsForCategories(),
    Default = {'All'},
    Multi = true,
    Callback = function(V)
        getgenv().SelectedBrainrots = V
    end
})

local function isTarget(obj)
    local nameAttr = obj:GetAttribute('Name')
    if not nameAttr then
        return false
    end
    local validNames = getValidNames()
    if not validNames[nameAttr] then
        return false
    end
    local selected = getgenv().SelectedBrainrots
    if selected['All'] then
        return true
    end
    return selected[nameAttr] ~= nil
end

Value:AddToggle('FarmToggle', {
    Title = 'Auto Take',
    Default = false,
    Callback = function(V)
        getgenv().AutoFarmEnabled = V
        if V then
            task.spawn(function()
                local nextAreaTeleport = 0
                while getgenv().AutoFarmEnabled do
                    pcall(function()
                        if isDead() then
                            setClaimFreeze(false)
                            return
                        end

                        if lp:GetAttribute('CarryingBrainrot') == true then
                            setClaimFreeze(true)
                            local ohString1 = 'ClaimBrainrots'
                            while getgenv().AutoFarmEnabled and lp:GetAttribute('CarryingBrainrot') == true do
                                game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage').Modules.EventManagerClient.ServerEvent:FireServer(ohString1)
                                task.wait(1)
                                if isDead() then
                                    break
                                end
                            end
                            setClaimFreeze(false)
                        else
                            setClaimFreeze(false)
                            local brainrotsWorld = gameplay and gameplay:FindFirstChild('Brainrots')
                            local target = nil
                            local targetPrompt = nil

                            if brainrotsWorld then
                                for _, br in ipairs(brainrotsWorld:GetChildren()) do
                                    if isTarget(br) then
                                        local mesh = br:FindFirstChild('Mesh')
                                        local prompt = mesh and mesh:FindFirstChildWhichIsA('ProximityPrompt')
                                        if prompt and prompt.Enabled then
                                            target = br
                                            targetPrompt = prompt
                                            break
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end

                            if target and targetPrompt and getRoot() then
                                local root = getRoot()
                                repeat
                                    if target and target.Parent and targetPrompt.Enabled and targetPrompt.Parent:IsA('BasePart') and root then
                                        root.CFrame = targetPrompt.Parent.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 2, 0)
                                        fireproximityprompt(targetPrompt)
                                    end
                                    task.wait(0.08)
                                until (not getgenv().AutoFarmEnabled) or (not target) or (not target.Parent) or (not targetPrompt.Enabled) or (lp:GetAttribute('CarryingBrainrot') == true) or isDead()
                            else
                                local root = getRoot()
                                if root then
                                    local now = os.clock()
                                    if now >= nextAreaTeleport then
                                        local fallbackArea = findFallbackArea(now)
                                        if fallbackArea then
                                            local enemyTarget = fallbackArea:FindFirstChild('TungTungSahurENEMY')
                                            local tpCFrame = getTeleportCFrame(enemyTarget or fallbackArea)
                                            if tpCFrame then
                                                root.CFrame = tpCFrame * CFrame.new(0, 3, 0)
                                                lastFallbackAreaName = fallbackArea.Name
                                                lastFallbackTeleportAt = now
                                                nextAreaTeleport = now + 1.5
                                            end
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                                task.wait(0.1)
                            end
                        end
                    end)
                    task.wait(0.05)
                end
                setClaimFreeze(false)
            end)
        else
            setClaimFreeze(false)
        end
    end
})
